title: He spent three years on one investigation - from Silicon Valley to China to the US border. It just won a Pulitzer.

sources.text: NPR - Here are the 2026 Pulitzer Prize winners

caption:
He spent three years on one investigation - from Silicon Valley to China to the US border. It just won a Pulitzer.

The prize, announced May 4, 2026, honoured an investigation into state-of-the-art mass surveillance tools - tracing their path from Silicon Valley, through development in China, to eventual use by US Border Patrol.

Ghosal, an AP reporter based in Hanoi covering business and climate in Southeast Asia, shared the prize with three other AP journalists and a contributor - one of the most prestigious honours in journalism.

Ghosal's Pulitzer came from investigating surveillance technology's path across three continents - Indian-origin reporting talent working at the highest level of international accountability journalism.
